name: CP Decomposition
definition: A tensor decomposition technique that factorizes a tensor into a sum of rank-one components (outer products of vectors). In TensoRF, it is applied to the 4D radiance field tensor to reduce memory footprint and enable efficient reconstruction.
summary: CP Decomposition factorizes radiance fields into rank-one vector sums, offering higher compactness than Tucker decomposition but requiring more components for complex scenes.
